hemisphere.Description: Side as given in contact_info.mat (field 'side': left/right)

atlas_label_AAL3.Description: AAL3v1 atlas label at the contact's MNI coordinate (nearest labelled voxel within 3-4 mm; fsaverage aseg white-matter fallback), looked up by the ieeg-atlas project (report/ieeg-atlas/build/coord_regions.py) on the coordinates in this file. Derived label, not given by the authors; the template variant is assumed MNI152.
